<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Pool timed out</span></div>

## Why it happens

Every connection in SENTIENT's pool was busy. Usually the database is too slow for the load: it is at full CPU or disk, or a long query blocks others. Less often, the pool is too small for the load.

## Fix it

1. Check the database's CPU and disk at the time of the error.
2. If the database is overloaded, give it more resources, shorten retention, or move history to ClickHouse.
3. If the database has spare capacity, raise `DB_POOL_PRIMARY_MAX` and PostgreSQL's `max_connections` together.

See [Performance tuning](/docs/operations/tuning/#database-connections).

## Check that it worked

The log shows no new `Pool timed out` lines under the same load.
